data.long_meaning: The name Georgianna is derived from the Greek name Georgios, which means 'farmer' or 'earth worker'. In Christian tradition, this name is associated with Saint George, a martyr and soldier renowned for his courage and faith. Georgianna is a feminine variation of Georgios and carries the same spiritual meaning. The name Georgianna carries the meaning “George's farmer, earth worker” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Georgianna usually hope their child will grow to embody george's farmer, earth worker and live with faith, good character and purpose.
